featured_reviews.name: Alice Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very disappointing experience. The property has serious health hazards, including black mould right next to the bed.
The management is unprofessional and disrespectful toward students, and the pricing is far too high for the conditions provided. Their policies also seem designed to make it difficult to get your deposit back. I would strongly advise against staying here.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Alice,

We are truly surprised to read your review.

During your 8-month stay with us (June 2025 to February 2026), you never raised any written complaint regarding hygiene or management. In fact, at the time of check-out, you personally wrote in our register that your stay was “Amazing, value for money, nice & comfortable with all necessary amenities. Caretakers & staff are efficient and friendly.”

We respect every resident’s feedback, which is why this sudden change is disappointing.

Regarding the deposit deduction, as clearly mentioned in our rules and agreed upon at the time of admission (with your signature), a one-month notice period is mandatory before vacating. Since the required notice period was not served, 20 days’ charges were adjusted from the security deposit as per policy. This rule is applied uniformly to all residents to maintain fairness and operational planning.

Our policies are transparent and shared in writing with every student at the time of booking. There are no hidden charges, and deposits are settled strictly as per the signed agreement.

We genuinely wish you the best for your future. If you still feel there is any misunderstanding, we are always open to discussing it respectfully.

Thank you.
Team Nidhaan Nest

featured_reviews.name: RISHABH
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is an outcome and vision of philanthropy and public spiritedness of old school business and something which we don't see nowadays. A hostel built on the ideals of women empowerment and social upliftment, this infrastructure allows a safe and secure residential accommodation in Mumbai for working women. The locality is not that great and safe to be precise and needs overhaul and immediate consideration by the local authorities. Although the locality of the hostel is a middle income area but the approach road and the adjacent place of the hostel is not safe for females because drunk local play cards and drink alcohol just outside the hostel although they are not an active threat, yet potential danger looms if your office working hours are late. The hostel is gated and manned by hostel staff and generally safe. The hostel has basic creature comfort and needs improvement, but are yet to get a filtered RO water purifier for the residents. Food served is not healthy at all and its nutritional value is poor the reason often given is the low price charged but the hostel is anyways a not for profit organisation and serving poor quality and quantity food in 2023 in a developing economy by a charitable institution run by one of India's largest corporate puts question on the overall management. Summarising the entire review, for potential residents they have a good place in Mumbai and it gives you a family safe place to grow financially in India's most expensive city at the same time the management needs to improve the infrastructure and use its CSR funds to overhaul and upgrade the hostel and make the residents feel like home, empowered and not that they are  at the mercy of some corporate magnate as it would be anthesis to the real value, philosophy and objectives of the Birla and ideals of Rajashreeji Birla.

featured_reviews.name: eva bara
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a safe and affordable place for outstation working women in Mumbai. I have stayed  here but vacated in Nov 2020 since I am working  from home due to coron lock down. There are room available as 2 seaters, 3 seaters & 4 seater. Room is allotted based on salary. No attached toilets bathrooms - it is common. You get hot water for bathing, drinking. Toilets bathrooms are cleaned everyday. Food is clean too and good. compared to other hostels it is pretty cheap at the price you get it. No non- veg though for  non-vegies, you  get good, healthy vegetarian food. Time deadline 10pm. In case you want to stay out any particular day give prior information or in case of an emergency inform the Superintendent. Everybody is helpful  and nice if you are nice, responsible and mindful of others to. Don't cause troubles for others, follow common rules, be respectful, n you will be fine here.
